\r
def _clean_relative_path(raw: object) -> str | None:\r
    """Return ``raw`` when it is a safe path relative to ``data/``, else ``None``."""\r
    if not isinstance(raw, str) or raw == "":\r
        return None\r
    if os.path.isabs(raw):\r
        return None\r
    segments = raw.split("/")\r
    if any(segment in ("", ".", "..") for segment in segments):\r
        return None\r
    return "/".join(segments)\r

\r
def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:\r
    raw = params.get("id")\r
    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():\r
        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}\r
    user = users.get_user(int(raw))\r
    if user is None:\r
        return 404, {"error": "not found"}\r
    return 200, user\r
\r
\r
def handle_file_digest(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:\r
    path = _clean_relative_path(params.get("path"))\r
    if path is None:\r
        return 400, {"error": "invalid path"}\r
    try:\r
        exists = (_DATA_DIR / path).is_file()\r
    except (OSError, ValueError):\r
        exists = False\r
    if not exists:\r

    result = subprocess.run(\r

        capture_output=True,\r
        text=True,\r
        check=False,\r
    )\r

        return 404, {"error": "not found"}\r
    return 200, json.loads(result.stdout)\r

import json\r
import os\r
import subprocess\r
import sys\r
from pathlib import Path\r

def _clean_relative_path(raw: object) -> str | None:\r
    """Return ``raw`` when it is a safe path relative to ``data/``, else ``None``."""\r
    if not isinstance(raw, str) or raw == "":\r
        return None\r
    if os.path.isabs(raw):\r
        return None\r
    segments = raw.split("/")\r
    if any(segment in ("", ".", "..") for segment in segments):\r
        return None\r
    return "/".join(segments)\r

    raw = params.get("id")\r

    user = users.get_user(int(raw))\r
    if user is None:\r
        return 404, {"error": "not found"}\r
    return 200, user\r
\r
\r

        text=True,\r

    )\r
    if result.returncode != 0:\r
        return 404, {"error": "not found"}\r
    return 200, json.loads(result.stdout)\r
